senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עוּף I) [bend, wing; cmp. כָּנָף,] bird, fowl.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:13">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (quoted fr. <he>כתובים</he>) <he>כל ע׳ למינו ישכון ובן אדם לדומה לו</he> (not <he>ובני</he>; Tosaf. <he>ע׳ כנף</he>) every bird nests according to (with) its kind, and man with one like himself; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 116:2">Yalk. Gen. 116</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 67:1">Yalk. Jud. 67</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 27b:16">Ḥull. 27ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין שחיטה לע׳ מן התורה</he> the ritual slaughtering of birds is not indicated in the Torah.

<cite ref="Shabbat 130a:11">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>במקומו … בשר ע׳ בחלב</he> in the native town of R. J. the Galilean they ate poultry prepared with milk; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עוֹפוֹת</he>. Ḥull. l. c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Gen. R. s. 67</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00935"><he>סִכְסֵךְ</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
